invariants: Each judge reads the frozen oracle, candidate bodies and cited predecessor evidence independently.
The orchestrator does not prefill verdicts and a principal/static validation is not a judge decision.
Any material correction invalidates both decisions and requires both judges to review the corrected bytes.
A later layer is released only after both persistent judges accept the predecessor.
